seccion.sub: What keeps your students coming back: content that opens as they level up, rewards delivered automatically, badges, streaks and celebrations in the community.
seccion.apagado: Points and challenges are turned off in your academy. Turn them on to use rewards and levels.
seccion.error: It could not be saved. Please try again.

niveles.ayuda: Each level is reached by earning its points: posting, commenting, finishing courses or completing challenges. Level 1 is the one with the fewest points.
niveles.vacio: There are no levels yet. Create at least two to lock content or give rewards.

cierres.ayuda: The course, or one of its sections, shows a lock until the person reaches the level. Then it opens on its own and they get notified.
cierres.reglaPago: If the course is paid, reaching the level does not give it away: whoever bought it always gets in, and anyone else can still buy it. Tick "Give it away" only if you want the level to grant free access.
cierres.regalar: Give it away when they reach the level (even if it is paid)

premios.ayuda: Delivered automatically when someone reaches a level or a number of points, with a notification and an email, and logged.
premios.codigoAviso: You create the discount code in your payments account (for example, a Stripe promotion code). Here it is only delivered: Didacta does not create coupons.
premios.mensajePh: For example, the day and time of the private live session
premios.entregados: {count, plural, =0 {Not delivered yet} one {Delivered to # person} other {Delivered to # people}}
premios.registroVacio: No reward has been delivered yet.

insignias.ayuda: Earned automatically at each milestone and shown on the profile and the member card. You can turn them off or rename them.

rachas.ayuda: Days and weeks in a row with activity (posting, commenting or progressing in a course). A day without activity breaks nothing until it is over, and we never warn that a streak is about to be lost.

celebraciones.ayuda: Posted automatically, in your name, in the General space. If several of the same kind happen on the same day, they go out in a single post. Each member can choose not to appear.
celebraciones.intros: Welcome when someone introduces themselves (their first post or comment)

alumno.rachaNota: Days in a row with activity. Today counts until midnight.

alumno.mejor: Your best streak: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
